map.按儿童月龄对照发育里程碑，评估粗大运动、精细运动、语言、社交四大能区发育情况: Compare developmental milestones by age in months across gross motor, fine motor, language, and social domains
map.提示：里程碑出现时间有个体差异。若某能区落后>2个月(婴儿期)或>3个月(幼儿期: Note: milestone timing varies individually. If a domain lags >2 months (infancy) or >3 months (toddler), refer for developmental assessment. Red flags: no smile at 4 mo, no reaching at 6 mo, no sitting at 9 mo, no crawling/pointing at 12 mo, no walking/ba-ma at 18 mo, no 2-word phrase at 24 mo, no sentences at 36 mo. This tool is for screening reference only.
map.18 月应独走、说单词、指认；达成率≥80% 为正常，<50% 明显落后。: At 18 mo should walk, say words, point; attainment ≥80% normal, <50% clearly delayed.
map.单能区达成率<50%→明显落后，尽早早期干预。: Single-domain attainment <50% -> clearly delayed, early intervention ASAP.
map.按语/运/社交逐月龄列出，慢 2 个月以上需警惕。: Listed by month for speech/motor/social; lag >2 months warrants vigilance.
map.矫正月龄(减早产周数)评估至 2 岁。: Use corrected age (subtract preterm weeks) until age 2.
map.儿童发育里程碑评估器，按月龄评估粗大运动、精细运动、语言、社交四大能区发育情况。: The pediatric developmental-milestones assessor evaluates gross-motor, fine-motor, language and social domains by age in months. A medical professional tool based on authoritative standards, for reference only.
map.🍚 6–12 月龄辅食量与铁来源参考: 🍚 Reference: complementary food amounts and iron sources at 6–12 months
map.按 WHO 婴幼儿喂养补充食品能量密度与餐次建议做粗略对照；奶量、早产、疾病与过: Rough comparison with WHO complementary-food energy density and meal-frequency guidance; milk intake, prematurity, illness, and allergies require individualized pediatric/dietitian assessment.
map.参考口径：6–8 月龄每日约 2–3 餐、补充食品约 200 kcal；9–11: Reference: at 6–8 months about 2–3 meals and 200 kcal from complementary foods per day; at 9–11 months 3–4 meals and about 300 kcal; at 12 months about 550 kcal plus 1–2 snacks. Prioritize iron-rich foods daily (iron-fortified cereal, red meat, liver/blood products), increasing meat puree from 25 g toward 50 g. Before age 1, milk remains the main energy source; complementary foods should not displace milk. This is not a diagnosis or feeding prescription.
